name: Giving Time To Jesus
overview: Scripture calls believers to prioritize their relationship with Jesus by dedicating time to Him through prayer, seeking God's kingdom and righteousness above all else, and abiding in Christ as the source of spiritual life and fruitfulness. Isaiah emphasizes the joy found in God's house of prayer, while Jesus invites His followers to remain steadfast in Him, despite challenges. Salvation is found exclusively in Jesus, underscoring the importance of giving Him our time and devotion.
